text:
kevin_sales: FYI 48Tech POC blocked: customers can't SSO into Private tenant and SCIM is creating weird duplicates. Demo in 24h. Need quick triage.

mia_pse: Is this hosted token or private control plane?

kevin_sales: Private control plane (tenant t-048). They initially used hosted metadata for quick tests, then switched. Now SAML fails with Audience and Destination mismatch.

omar_eng: Sounds like the IdP has the wrong EntityID/ACS. Private tenants use tenant-scoped endpoints. Tell them to import the tenant metadata at `https://private.redwood-inference.com/t-048/saml/metadata`. ACS must be `https://private.redwood-inference.com/t-048/saml/consume`.

rachel_platform: Also on SCIM: Okta shows two creates for same user. The logs show Okta POST then retry on timeout. Our SCIM returns 201 with Location header; some Okta integrations expect 200/204 for PATCH flows and will retry.

kevin_sales: They also reported a cert mismatch when validating metadata.

omar_eng: That means they probably imported an old file. I'll regenerate the tenant metadata XML and signed cert.

mia_pse: Quick workaround for the demo: we can provision a hosted demo tenant and issue hosted API keys for sign-in. Not ideal but low friction. Data isolation note required.

rachel_platform: Fixes to recommend to IdP admin: 1) Re-import the tenant metadata XML we provide. 2) Set EntityID and ACS to the tenant URLs above. 3) Ensure the SAML audience matches the EntityID exactly. 4) Map Okta `externalId` -> SCIM `externalId` to prevent duplicate creates.

omar_eng: I'll also enable `normalize_email` for t-048 to canonicalize `joe+test` vs `joe.test`. That should stop dupes from Okta transforms.

kevin_sales: Timeline? Demo tomorrow morning. If they re-import now, can we validate?

omar_eng: If they re-import and confirm, we can validate end-to-end in ~2 hours. I'll block time.

mia_pse: I'll message the IdP admin and offer hosted fallback if they can't finish in time.

audit_bot: Note: POC hosted token `poc-demo-t048` was rotated 2025-01-08T14:22:00Z. If using hosted fallback, use the new token.

kevin_sales: OK assigning: @omar_eng regen metadata + cert, @rachel_platform write SCIM mapping steps + Okta screenshots, @mia_pse coordinate with Tech IdP. I'll update the customer.

rachel_platform: Posting mapping checklist and screenshots in 10m.

omar_eng: Scheduling 90-min verification window now.
